records.read_kind: Bounded targeted primary text plus visual table verification; not a full-paper read

exact_read_scope.scope: Target dataset overview/characteristics and section 4 fixed random/temporal/transductive/inductive splits; only relevant task details and split prose
Sections 5.1/5.2/5.3 models, native RL results in Table 2 and random/temporal comparisons; targeted Tolokers2 and Artnetviews rows
Appendix A.1 target dataset descriptions and relevant A.2 property definitions; not all dataset narratives
Appendix B.1 native GNN/GFM recipe, NFA definition, and B.3 training/hyperparameter setup
Table 6 targeted TH rows for Tolokers2 and Artnetviews

records.method_takeaway: Industrial typed-feature graph tasks with fixed RL/RH/TH/THI splits, competent full-batch residual GNNs and competitive GBDT+NFA. Native GAT/GT are stronger than GCN for RL Tolokers2; native GCN is competitive for Artnetviews and TH on both targets.
records.supported_integration_implication: Prospectively freeze exact release, split, source recipe, preprocessing, metric, graph-loop and target-transform semantics. Do not reuse R17 unchanged or claim graph-transformer uncertainty collapse.
limitations: Metadata/source inspection is not dataset verification or result reproduction.
GraphPFN is cited but not evaluated in GraphLand v5.
Fixed split plus repeated seeds does not establish graph-population uncertainty.
Paper Adam and pinned native AdamW descriptions differ; raw native training inspects test metrics.
80GB A100 author hardware does not establish minimum memory or local feasibility.

records.verified_title: GraphPFN: A Prior-Data Fitted Graph Foundation Model
records.read_kind: Bounded targeted primary text plus visual table verification; not a full-paper read

exact_read_scope.scope: Abstract, section 3 architecture/pretraining and learning-curve/pretraining-monitoring statement; targeted paragraphs, not complete pages
Section 5.1 datasets/baselines/metrics, Table 1 relevant GraphLand tasks, and shared-weight preprocessing ensemble paragraph
Appendices C/D ensemble/setup/runtime details and Tables 9/10; page 13 property/ablation prose and table visible during visual check were inspected but do not drive recommendation
Appendix E NodePFN scope caveat and Table 11 targeted Tolokers2 row

records.method_takeaway: LimiX-based graph-attention adapters pretrained on synthetic graphs provide strong RL results for both tasks. Ten shared-weight preprocessing members with random feature selection differ from independent trained ensembles.
records.supported_integration_implication: Include a contemporary pretrained baseline with separate cost and ensemble semantics. Static source has exact FT evaluation configs and materially different modern native GNN recipes.
limitations: Published values and timings are attributed, not independently reproduced.
GraphLand evaluation uses fixed RL only; no TH/THI advantage established.
Synthetic/LimiX pretraining is outside a cost-matched native GNN fit.
Authors state GraphLand pretraining test monitoring was post-hoc rather than model selection; this was not independently verified.
NodePFN comparison exceeds authors recommended context size.
Package/paper/source environment and preprocessing identities require prospective binding.
